# policyengine-us test files the PolicyEngineUSMain job runs from a checkout of
# policyengine-us main, first with the Core release on PyPI and then with the
# Core under test (.github/country_main_tests.py). Paths are relative to the
# policyengine-us repository root.
#
# Each file drives Core internals (simulations, holders, data storage, tools,
# populations, parameters or reforms) and is fast: together they took about
# 95 seconds in policyengine-us release run 40544965026. The state machine test
# runs Core's installed source bodies in namespaces it builds; Core 3.33.13
# broke it on 2026-10-27, which this job would have shown on the PR.
#
# A file policyengine-us renames or removes is skipped with a warning, so keep
# the list in step when that happens.
